guide-text: Upload a video, and the AI will find the clips containing a paperclip or a tape roll.
prompt-start: Extract from the video all scenes that match the description:

analyzes.ui-description: The paperclip is visible in these videos.
analyzes.prompt-middle: The paperclip is visible in the video.

analyzes.ui-description: The tape roll is visible in these videos.
analyzes.prompt-middle: The tape roll is visible in the video.

prompt-end: Respond only with the start and end times of each scene in the format: minutes:seconds-minutes:seconds. List multiple time ranges if there are several matching scenes. For example: 0:30-0:33, 1:15-1:18, 2:45-2:50.
